source_id: BW-GYM-01 STT Transition 1 — no membership to open
purpose: A student applying to a confirmed club with no prior application transitions the system from 'No Membership Application' to 'Membership Application Open'.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Confirmed club exists. No prior application from this student to this club. Guards: club is confirmed, no duplicate application.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/memberships/apply/ with club id and description.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Membership application record exists with status='open'. BR-GYM-007, BR-GYM-008, BR-GYM-009 all satisfied.

source_id: BW-GYM-01 STT Transition 1 guard — unconfirmed club blocks open state
purpose: If the target club is not confirmed, the transition to 'Membership Application Open' is blocked.

source_id: BW-GYM-01 STT Transition 2 — open to confirmed (membership approved)
purpose: An applicable Club Head approving an open membership application transitions it to 'Membership Confirmed'.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Open membership application exists for the club. BR-GYM-010, BR-GYM-011 applicable.

source_id: BW-GYM-01 STT Transition 2 guard — unauthorized Club Head cannot approve
purpose: If the approving actor is not the applicable Club Head, the transition to 'Membership Confirmed' is blocked.
preconditions: Club Head of Club B tries to approve an application belonging to Club A.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/memberships/{id}/approve/ where application belongs to Club A.

source_id: BW-GYM-01 full path — no membership → open → confirmed
purpose: The complete BW-GYM-01 workflow: student applies (open), Club Head approves (confirmed).
preconditions: Student S, Club Head H, confirmed club C. No prior application from S to C.
action_or_input: Step 1: S calls POST /apply/ → application open. Step 2: H calls POST /approve/ → application confirmed.
expected_result: After step 1: status='open'. After step 2: status='confirmed'. Full path completes without error.

source_id: BW-GYM-02 STT Transition 1 — poll not available to poll open
purpose: An authorized Club Head creating a poll with valid data transitions the system from 'Poll Not Available' to 'Poll Open / Target Audience Defined / Student Not Yet Voted'.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. At least two choices. Valid target groups. BR-GYM-010, BR-GYM-012, BR-GYM-013 applicable.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Poll with status='active', choices, and target groups created.

source_id: BW-GYM-02 STT Transition 1 guard — fewer than two choices blocks creation
purpose: If fewer than two choices are provided, the poll creation transition is blocked.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Poll not created. State remains 'Poll Not Available'.

source_id: BW-GYM-02 STT Transition 2 — not voted to vote recorded
purpose: An eligible targeted student voting in an active poll transitions from 'Student Not Yet Voted' to 'Student Vote Recorded'.
preconditions: Active poll. Student in target batch/branch. Student has not voted. Poll not expired. BR-GYM-013, BR-GYM-014, BR-GYM-015 applicable.
expected_result: HTTP 200/201. Vote recorded. Choice tally incremented by 1.

source_id: BW-GYM-02 STT Transition 2 guard — already voted blocks second vote
purpose: A student who has already voted cannot transition again; second vote is rejected.
preconditions: Student has already voted in the poll.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. No duplicate vote. Tally unchanged.

source_id: BW-GYM-02 STT Transition 2 guard — expired poll blocks vote
purpose: If the poll has expired, the student cannot vote even if otherwise eligible.
preconditions: Poll expires_at is in the past. Student eligible and not yet voted.

source_id: BW-GYM-02 full path — poll created → eligible student votes
purpose: The complete BW-GYM-02 workflow: Club Head creates poll (active), eligible student votes (vote recorded).
preconditions: Club Head H, eligible student S. No prior votes by S in this poll.
action_or_input: Step 1: H creates poll via POST /polls/ → status='active'. Step 2: S votes via POST /polls/{id}/vote/.
expected_result: After step 1: poll active with choices and target groups. After step 2: vote recorded, tally incremented.

source_id: BW-GYM-03 STT Transition 1 — club not created to club open
purpose: Student Admin creating a club with valid data transitions from 'Club Not Created' to 'Club Open'.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. Valid coordinator/co-coordinator (students), valid faculty councillor, allowed category. BR-GYM-001 to BR-GYM-004 applicable.

source_id: BW-GYM-03 STT Transition 1 guard — invalid coordinator blocks club creation
purpose: If the coordinator is not a valid student, the transition to 'Club Open' is blocked.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. coordinator_id refers to a non-student.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Club not created. State remains 'Club Not Created'.

source_id: BW-GYM-03 STT Transition 2 — club open to club confirmed
purpose: Student Admin approving an open club transitions it from 'Club Open' to 'Club Confirmed'.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated. Club exists with status='open'. BR-GYM-004 applicable.

source_id: BW-GYM-03 STT Transition 2 guard — non-Student-Admin cannot confirm club
purpose: If the actor is not Student Admin, the transition to 'Club Confirmed' is blocked.
preconditions: Regular student (not Student Admin) authenticated. Open club exists.

source_id: BW-GYM-03 full path — club not created → open → confirmed
purpose: The complete BW-GYM-03 workflow: Student Admin creates club (open), then confirms it (confirmed).
preconditions: Student Admin A, valid coordinator, co-coordinator, faculty councillor.
action_or_input: Step 1: A calls POST /clubs/ → club open. Step 2: A calls POST /clubs/{id}/confirm/ → club confirmed.
expected_result: After step 1: status='open'. After step 2: status='confirmed'. Full path completes.
